id: MOTCI: our estimate vs the centroidal+IMU estimate (Fedsi 2026, RA_EST_ALT=cimu) in the final controller during the robot's own arm motion, with and without a push
registered: 2026-11-05 before any MOTCI run on the registered seeds. Purpose: the paper's arm-motion advantage over the centroidal estimate (ESTCMP2: false entries 6 vs 8 of 12, post-hoc paired peaks 11/12) is offline replay on logs of an earlier controller; it was never tested in closed loop. Dev evidence: one smoke run per arm (gesture + x+50 N, seed 1300) to check the pipeline: both recovered without a step. Nothing else was run.

arms.OURS: final controller LCMHF, exactly as HFFINAL/COST1 (run_motci.sh, OURS_E)
arms.CI: the same controller and flags with RA_EST_ALT=cimu (centroidal estimate with the IMU, without joint accelerations), as in EST1b

conditions: ACCAD arm motions lift, swing, gesture, jab from t = 2 s (looped), each with no push, 0.2 s impulse x+50 N or y-50 N at 3 s; seeds 1370-1375 (new). 4 x 3 x 6 = 72 runs per arm, 144 in total.

metrics.spurious estimate (no-push runs): peak over 2.0-6.0 s of the horizontal norm of d6 minus its mean over 1.0-1.9 s (before the motion), from ctrl_rows (N)
metrics.false hold entries (no-push runs): number of off->on transitions of dbg.est_on at t >= 2.0 s; a run is a false-entry run if it has at least one
metrics.costs (push runs): as COST1 over 2.9-6.0 s: net horizontal base displacement, peak foot force, leg work, on runs recovered by both

analysis: paired on motion, cell and seed. One-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank for continuous metrics, exact one-sided McNemar for paired binary outcomes.

predictions.M1 (primary, no-push, 24 pairs): peak spurious estimate OURS < CI, one-sided Wilcoxon p < 0.01
predictions.M2 (no-push, 24 pairs): false-entry runs OURS <= CI and steps OURS <= CI
predictions.M3 (primary closed loop, push during mot: held in place OURS > CI, exact one-sided McNemar p < 0.05

reported: per-motion table; steps and costs in push runs; peak spurious estimate per motion; whether the estimate advantage (M1) carries over to the closed loop (M3) is the question - M1 pass with M3 fail will be reported as 'quieter estimate, no closed-loop difference'
